study_status: Exploratory retrospective evaluation on previously inspected datasets; not independent confirmatory validation.

interpretation.primary_comparison: evidence_gate_delta_0p5pp minus source_fixed at 20 percent capacity; report every dataset and all three fixed comparators separately
interpretation.threshold_origin: 0.5 percentage points is a fixed analysis scenario, not an elicited educational utility or an estimated optimum
interpretation.gate: Switch from source-selected rule to source-selected LR/HGB only if the empirical lower quantile of paired source-course cross-fitted gains strictly exceeds delta; otherwise use rule
interpretation.uncertainty: Source quantile is a heuristic with only 3-4 validation courses, not a calibrated confidence guarantee. Report intervals are conditional paired course bootstraps, without multiplicity adjustment.
interpretation.primary_vs_sensitivity: All new policies use joint three-capacity source tuning. Do not substitute their 20 percent points into the archived single-capacity primary tables.
